item.title: JetBrains reported a net financial loss first time in its tracked history
Gleam doesn't compile to Erlang source anymore
item.description:
📝 Previously Gleam generated Erlang source code, now it generates Erlang abstract forms. We have moved from from compiling from source code that is fed to the Erlang compiler to an intermediate-representation that is fed into the Erlang compiler, but why not bypass the Erlang compiler altogether. Couldn't we make a BEAM bytecode generator that outperforms the Erlang compiler.
🔗 Read more: https://gleam.run/news/gleam-doesnt-compile-to-erlang-source-anymore/

item.title: Nature's capacity to 'bounce back' when species are lost is vastly overestimated
item.description:
📝 Across most of the benefits ecosystems provide that we looked at, the data doesn't support that. This indicates that so-called blue carbon sinks—the ocean and coastal ecosystems such as coral reefs, salt marshes or mangroves that capture and store carbon dioxide from the atmosphere—depend on sustaining diverse marine communities, from phytoplankton to the microbial food webs that pump carbon into deep water. The authors argue that conservation must therefore balance maintaining overall diversity with safeguarding irreplaceable foundational species.
🔗 Read more: https://phys.org/news/2026-10-nature-capacity-species-lost-vastly.html

item.title: World's First enhanced geothermal power plant completed in just 23 months
item.description:
📝 Geothermal company Fervo Energy announced Thursday morning that it had started selling electricity from its Cape Station power plant to the grid on September 30, one day ahead of schedule. With it, Fervo becomes the first enhanced geothermal company to reach a key commercial milestone. Fervo is one of several companies developing enhanced geothermal power plants.
🔗 Read more: https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/01/worlds-first-enhanced-geothermal-power-plant-completed-in-just-23-months/
